thread:
lee: Hi all, first day here. Trying to enroll my personal System76 (Pop!_OS 22.04) into Fleet/Kandji for repo + VPN access. Enrollment failing with "FDE not detected" even though disk is encrypted with LUKS. I use a detached header on a USB stick (company policy required inline header?) Who should I talk to about making this compliant or a temporary workaround?

it-support: Welcome, lee! Quick answer: our device trust check expects an inline LUKS header on the internal block device and TPM2 attestation where available. Detached headers are considered non-compliant because they break escrow/forensics. We can either help you reformat with the header inline (requires full backup + restore) or provide a company-managed machine or temporary cloud workspace.

lee: thanks. I do not have backups ready. Outputs: `sudo cryptsetup luksDump /dev/nvme0n1p3` shows "LUKS header: detached" and `lsblk -f` shows /dev/sdc1 labelled LUKS-HEADER (my USB).

kandji-bot: Compliance alert — enrollment blocked: FDE_POLICY_V2 (LUKS header not on internal device). Ticket #CMP-7783 opened. Network access limited until resolution.

security: FYI we rarely allow detached headers for corporate workloads. We can sign a short exception for read-only repo access but VPN + deploy keys require full compliance. If you want to keep this laptop for dev work, you'll need to re-encrypt with an inline header and bind the key to TPM2 or we can image a separate company partition. I'll DM the exception form if you want temporary limited access.

devops: We can spin up an ephemeral cloud-desktop (cloud-desktop-12) with repo + VPN-lite access for 7 days. If you just need to make a few PRs, that'll be fastest. If you need persistent dev environment, we can provision a loaner laptop.

lee: I'll take the cloud-desktop for now. Can someone confirm I still need to fill any forms for that? Also what's the checksum to verify I didn't nuke the wrong USB header when I try to move it later?

it-support: No forms required for the cloud-desktop, just ack the usage policy in the DM you'll get. For moving the header later: best practice is to `cryptsetup luksHeaderBackup --header-backup-file=backup.img /dev/nvme0n1p3` first, verify sha256sum of backup.img, then `cryptsetup luksHeaderRestore --header-backup-file=backup.img /dev/nvme0n1p3` when ready. We'll schedule a 1:1 if you want help.

security: Reminder — don't share backup.img on personal cloud drives. Keep it offline on an encrypted USB. We'll provide an official checklist for re-encryption steps.

devops: cloud-desktop-12 created. SSH + VPN-lite details DM'd. TTL 168h. If you need port-forwarding for local testing, reply here and we'll extend.

lee: Got SSH details, can connect. Huge thanks everyone, really smooth onboarding so far. One last Q: where's the new-hire checklist link?

it-support: https://intranet.company/new-hires/checklist — contains device, access, and payroll steps. Welcome aboard! :tada:
